statements.impact_statement: The affected NLTK path accepts attacker-controlled resource names in nltk.data.load/find. WhitePact's optional sentiment path only calls nltk.download with the hard-coded literal vader_lexicon and never routes user input into the affected APIs.
statements.status_notes: Owner: WhitePact maintainers. Re-evaluate by 2026-12-04, if the call path changes, or when NLTK publishes a fixed version. The sentiment extra remains opt-in.

statements.impact_statement: The affected NLTK APIs read or write caller-controlled model paths outside pathsec roots. WhitePact imports only nltk.sentiment.vader.SentimentIntensityAnalyzer and calls nltk.download with the hard-coded literal vader_lexicon. It does not call TransitionParser.train or parse, AveragedPerceptron.save or load, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json, or save_maxent_params.
statements.status_notes: Owner: WhitePact maintainers. No patched NLTK release exists as of 2026-09-04. Re-evaluate by 2026-12-04, if WhitePact's NLTK imports change, or when NLTK publishes a fixed version. The sentiment extra remains opt-in.
